brief.summary_1line: Rama lovingly questions Bharata about whether he governs Ayodhya justly, listing extensive principles of righteous kingship and statecraft.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama lifts the emaciated Bharata from the forest floor and embraces him while the gathered princes and forest dwellers watch with tears.
Bharata lies on the ground in ascetic garb with matted hair and folded palms before Rama in the forest hermitage.
